item.title: North Korea Fires Around 10 Short-Range Ballistic Missiles as Unprecedented US-South Korea Drills Get 'Halved' (초유의 한미훈련 ‘반토막’에... 北은 단거리탄도 10여발 발사)
item.description:
North Korea Fires Around 10 Short-Range Ballistic Missiles as Unprecedented US-South Korea Drills Get 'Halved' (초유의 한미훈련 ‘반토막’에... 北은 단거리탄도 10여발 발사)

North Korea fired around 10 short-range ballistic missiles, presumed to be 600mm super-large multiple rocket launchers, into the East Sea on the 20th. This comes as the South Korea-US military authorities reduced the regular defensive joint exercise 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' (UFS) by half, in line with President Donald Trump's expressed intent to engage in dialogue with North Korea. (북한이 20일 동해상으로 600mm 초대형방사포로 추정되는 단거리 탄도미사일 10여발을 발사했다. 북한과의 대화 의사를 밝힌 도널드 트럼프 대통령 뜻대로 한미 군 당국이 방어적 성격의 정례 한미연합훈련 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS)를 절반으로 줄인 상황에서다.)

The Joint Chiefs of Staff announced that it detected North Korea launching around 10 short-range ballistic missiles from the Pyongyang area into the East Sea that day. The missiles flew approximately 300km. Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek stated before the National Assembly's National Defense Committee that the ballistic missiles launched by North Korea were super-large multiple rocket launchers (KN-25). North Korea claims the KN-25, with a range of around 400km, can carry the tactical nuclear warhead 'Hwasan-31,' which it unveiled in 2023. The Ministry of National Defense confirmed for the first time that day that the KN-25 has been deployed in frontline areas near the Military Demarcation Line, which also implies that North Korea could carry out tactical nuclear strikes across the entire Korean Peninsula in case of emergencies. (합참은 이날 북한이 평양 일대에서 동해상으로 단거리 탄도미사일 10여발을 발사한 것을 포착했다고 밝혔다. 미사일은 300km 가량 비행했다. 안규백 장관은 북한이 발사한 탄도미사일이 초대형방사포(KN-25)라고 국회 국방위에서 밝혔다. KN-25는 사거리가 400km 안팎으로 북한이 2023년 공개한 전술핵탄두 ‘화산-31′을 탑재할 수 있다고 북한은 주장하고 있다. 국방부는 이날 처음으로 KN-25가 휴전선 일대 전방에 실전배치됐다고 확인했는데, 북한이 유사시 한반도 전역에 전술핵 공격을 감행할 수 있다는 의미기도 하다.)

The launch occurred during the theater-level South Korea-US joint exercise 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' (UFS), which runs from the 17th to the 21st. However, there are observations that North Korea showed consideration for China by conducting the launch after the visit of Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi, which began the previous day, had concluded. (이번 발사는 17일부터 21일까지 진행되는 전구급 한미 연합훈련 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS) 중에 이뤄졌다. 다만 전날부터 진행된 왕이 중국 외교부장의 한국 방문이 마무리된 이후 발사를 감행해 중국을 배려했다는 관측이 나온다.)

Earlier, Kim Yo-jong, vice department director of the Workers' Party of Korea, in a statement titled 'Position on Issues of Major Countries' released through the Korean Central News Agency the previous day, said that although the UFS exercise, which began on the 17th, was significantly reduced following President Donald Trump's instructions, she "does not think it is worth commenting on and has no interest in it at all." (앞서 북한 김여정 노동당 부장은 전날 조선중앙통신을 통해 발표한 ‘주요국 문제들에 대한 입장’에서 지난 17일부터 시작한 UFS 훈련이 도널드 트럼프 대통령 지시에 따라 대폭 축소됐으나 “그에 대해 평할 가치도 없다고 보며 전혀 흥미를 느끼지 않는다”고 했다.)

Kim Yo-jong had previously stated, "The reduction in scale or duration of the exercise does not change the nature of the military drills, which are provocative and aggressive in character." She added, "Regardless of the excellent relationship between the leaders of the DPRK and the US, it reminds us that the sovereign actions we take to deter forces threatening our national security are very commonsensical, accurate, and essential." (김여정은 “훈련의 규모나 기일이 줄어든다고 해서 도발적, 공격적 성격의 군사연습의 본질이 달라지는 것이 아니다”고 했었다. 그러면서 “조미(북미) 두 나라 지도자들 사이의 훌륭한 관계와는 무관하게 우리가 자국의 안전을 위협하는 세력들을 견제하기 위한 취해 나가는 주권적 행사들은 매우 상식적이고 적중하며 필수적인 것으로 된다는 것을 상기시킨다”고 했었다.)

Park Won-gon, a professor at Ewha Womans University, said, "This is a message that a reduction, not a 'suspension,' of the joint exercise is insufficient," and added, "By launching a ballistic missile capable of carrying a tactical nuclear warhead, it may also contain a message to recognize North Korea's nuclear status and begin discussions in future US-North Korea dialogue." (박원곤 이화여대 교수는 “연합훈련 ‘중단’이 아닌 축소로는 충분치 않다는 메시지”라며 “전술 핵탄두 탑재 가능한 탄도미사일을 발사해 향후 미북 대화 시 북한의 핵 보유를 인정하고 논의를 시작하자는 메시지도 담겨 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

This is North Korea's third ballistic missile launch this month, following launches on the 6th and the 12th. (북한의 탄도미사일 발사는 지난 6일과 12일에 이어 이달 들어 세번째다.)

Earlier, on the afternoon of the 6th, North Korea fired one short-range ballistic missile (SRBM) from the Wonsan area into the East Sea. On the 12th, around 6 a.m., it launched one ballistic missile from the Wonsan area into the East Sea. That missile flew over 700km. South Korean military authorities stated that additional analysis of the missile type was needed. North Korea did not disclose the launches or details through state media on either occasion. (앞서 북한은 지난 6일 오후 원산 일대에서 동해상으로 단거리 탄도미사일(SRBM) 1발을 쐈다. 지난 12일에는 오전 6시쯤 원산 일대에서 동해상으로 탄도미사일 1발을 발사했다. 당시 북한 미사일은 700km 이상을 비행했다. 우리 군 당국은 탄도미사일 탄종에 추가 분석이 필요하다는 입장을 밝혔다. 북한은 두 차례 발사 모두 관영매체 등을 통해 발사 사실 및 세부 내용을 공개하지 않았다.)

item.title: 'Architect of the Blue-Water Navy' Former Navy Chief of Staff Ahn Byung-tae Publishes Memoirs (‘대양해군의 설계자’ 안병태 전 해참총장, 회고록 출간)
item.description:
'Architect of the Blue-Water Navy' Former Navy Chief of Staff Ahn Byung-tae Publishes Memoirs (‘대양해군의 설계자’ 안병태 전 해참총장, 회고록 출간)

Former Navy Chief of Staff Ahn Byung-tae (Naval Academy Class 17) has published his memoirs, "From the Sea to the World, the Blue-Water Navy" (Yemi), detailing the process and behind-the-scenes stories of building the Navy's "Blue-Water Navy" during his tenure. (안병태 전 해군참모총장(해사 17기)이 재임 시절 해군의 ‘대양해군’ 건설 추진 과정과 비화를 담은 회고록 ‘바다로 세계로 대양해군’(예미)을 출간했다.)

Former Chief Ahn served as the 20th Navy Chief of Staff from April 1995 to April 1997. Immediately after taking office, he adopted "Preparing for the Blue-Water Navy" as his motto and is credited with laying the groundwork for transforming the Navy, which had been focused on coastal defense, into one capable of open-ocean operations. (안 전 총장은 1995년 4월부터 1997년 4월까지 제20대 해군참모총장을 지냈다. 그는 취임 직후 ‘대양해군 준비’를 표어로 내걸고, 연안 방어 중심이던 해군을 원양 작전 능력을 갖춘 해군으로 전환하는 기반을 마련했다는 평가를 받는다.)

The memoirs cover Former Chief Ahn's childhood, his years as a naval officer, and his life after retirement, with a significant portion devoted to the process of building the Blue-Water Navy and the behind-the-scenes decision-making of that time. A particularly noteworthy passage in the book is the briefing on naval force construction plans held at the Blue House in April 1996. When Former Chief Ahn reported to then-President Kim Young-sam on plans to secure Korean-built destroyers (KDX), large amphibious ships, submarines, and aircraft, former President Kim reportedly said, "That's a highly ambitious plan. Let's do it. We'll do it, Chief Ahn." This reportedly marked the beginning of full-fledged efforts to build the Blue-Water Navy. The forces that Former Chief Ahn envisioned at the time have since become the core strength of today's Republic of Korea Navy. This is why Former Chief Ahn is regarded as the "Architect of the Blue-Water Navy" and the "Father of the Blue-Water Navy." (회고록은 안 전 총장의 유년기와 해군 장교 시절, 전역 후 삶을 담았으며, 상당 부분을 대양해군 건설 과정과 당시의 의사결정 비화에 할애했다. 책에서 특히 주목되는 대목은 1996년 4월 청와대에서 이뤄진 해군 전력 건설 계획 보고다. 안 전 총장이 김영삼 당시 대통령에게 한국형 구축함(KDX), 대형 상륙함, 잠수함, 항공기 확보 계획을 보고하자 김 전 대통령은 “대단히 야심 찬 계획이구만. 해야지. 합시다, 안 총장”이라고 말했다고 한다. 이를 계기로 대양해군 건설은 본격적으로 추진되기 시작했다고 한다. 당시 안 총장이 구상했던 전력은 지금 한국 해군의 핵심 전력이 됐다. 안 전 총장이 ‘대양해군의 설계자’ ‘대양해군의 아버지’라고 평가받는 이유다.)

Former Chief Ahn defined the Blue-Water Navy as "a navy capable of conducting independent operations in the open ocean for about a month without external support, in order to support the nation's maritime activities and protect national interests." In his foreword, Former Chief Ahn wrote, "The Blue-Water Navy is not simply a concept of expanding the Navy's size or capabilities; it is the form the Navy must take to meet the responsibilities and roles the nation must shoulder in the world, and it is a concept premised on the Republic of Korea having grown from a nation that only receives protection into one that contributes to and shares responsibility in the international community." (안 전 총장은 대양해군을 “국민의 해양 활동 지원 및 국가 이익 수호를 위해 외부 지원 없이 약 한 달간 대양에서 독자 작전을 수행할 수 있는 해군”으로 정의했다. 안 전 총장은 서문에서 “대양해군은 단순히 해군의 규모나 전력을 키우는 개념이 아니라, 국가가 세계 속에서 감당해야 할 책임과 역할에 부응하기 위해 갖추어야 할 해군의 모습이고, 대한민국이 더 이상 보호만 받는 나라가 아니라, 국제사회에 기여하고 책임을 나누는 나라로 성장했음을 전제로 한 개념”이라고 했다.)

Junior officer and former Navy Chief of Staff Yang Yong-mo said in his recommendation, "The Blue-Water Navy is not only the path the Navy must take, but also the path the Republic of Korea must take," adding, "This memoir serves as a compass and companion on the Republic of Korea's journey toward becoming a maritime power and a blue-water navy, and it is also a solemn message to press forward without wavering." (후배인 양용모 전 해군참모총장은 추천사를 통해 “대양해군은 해군이 갈 길이기도 하지만, 대한민국이 가야 할 길이기도 하다”며 “이번 회고록은 대한민국이 해양 강국, 대양해군으로 나아가는 길에 나침반이자 길동무이고, 흔들림 없이 나아가라는 엄중한 메시지이기도 하다”라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "President leaving party? Ignorance of the Constitution"... Lee Seok-yeon: "It's Kim Min-seok who doesn't know the Constitution" (김민석 “대통령 탈당? 헌법 무지”... 이석연 “헌법 모르는 건 김민석”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: "President leaving party? Ignorance of the Constitution"... Lee Seok-yeon: "It's Kim Min-seok who doesn't know the Constitution" (김민석 “대통령 탈당? 헌법 무지”... 이석연 “헌법 모르는 건 김민석”)

Backlash is erupting over Lee Seok-yeon, chairman of the Presidential Committee for National Integration, who suggested that President Lee Jae-myung leave the Democratic Party of Korea. Representative Kim Min-seok called it "based on ignorance or misunderstanding of the Constitution," while Chairman Lee fired back, saying, "Rather, that kind of remark shows a lack of knowledge of the Constitution." (더불어민주당에서 이재명 대통령의 탈당을 건의한 이석연 대통령직속 국민통합위원장을 둘러싼 반발이 터져나오고 있다. 김민석 대표는 “헌법에 대한 무지 내지는 오해에 기초한 것”이라고 했고, 이 위원장은 “오히려 그런 발언이 헌법을 모르고 하는 소리”라고 맞받았다.)

At a general meeting of lawmakers held at the National Assembly on the 20th, Representative Kim Min-seok said, "Today, I heard from a person in a relatively influential public position suggesting that for the President to become 'the President of everyone,' it might be more fitting to step away from party affiliation," adding, "From the party's standpoint, this is a logic we can never accept, and it doesn't align with history either." (김민석 대표는 20일 국회에서 열린 의원총회에서 “오늘 보니까 대통령께서 ‘모두의 대통령’이 되기 위해서 당적을 벗어나는 게 오히려 더 부합하지 않느냐는 비교적 영향력 있는 공직에 계신 분의 말씀이 있었다”며 “당 입장에서 결코 수용할 수 없는 논리이고, 역사적으로도 맞지 않는 논리”라고 했다.)

Kim said, "Former President Roh Moo-hyun attempted 'separation of party and government,' and that has continued to some extent to this day, but Roh himself said late in his term that the separation had gone wrong and needed to be restored," adding, "Historical experience has accumulated." He then noted that Article 105 of the Democratic Party's constitution defines the relationship between the party and the President, stating, "A party member elected as President has the authority to participate in determining party lines and the duty to implement them during their term." (김 대표는 “노무현 전 대통령 때 ‘당정 분리’를 시도했고 그것이 일정하게 현재도 내려오고 있는데, 노 전 대통령이 임기 말 당정 분리가 잘못돼 이것을 회복해야 한다고 하신 바 있다”며 “역사적 경험이 축적돼 있다”고 했다. 이어 민주당 당헌 105조에 당과 대통령 관계가 정리돼 있다며 “대통령에 당선된 당원은 재임 기간 동안 당론 결정에 참여할 권한과 당론을 이행할 의무를 가진다”고 했다.)

Kim said, "The discussion of a first-year President leaving the party is based on ignorance or misunderstanding of the Constitution," adding, "It also doesn't hold up under the principle of responsible governance." Fellow party lawmaker Kim Young-jin also said, "Chairman Lee Seok-yeon seems to have made remarks that don't foster national unity but rather slightly disrupt it," adding, "In party politics, the President is affiliated with a party, so discussing leaving the party in the first year of a term is, I think, going too far." (김 대표는 “임기 1년차 대통령 당적 이탈 논의는 헌법에 대한 무지 내지는 오해에 기초한 것”이라며 “책임정치 원칙에 비춰봤을 때도 맞지 않다”고 했다. 같은 당 김영진 의원도 “이석연 위원장이 국민통합을 만드는 게 아니라 국민통합을 약간 어지럽히는 발언을 한 것 같다”며 “정당정치에서 대통령이 정당 소속인 부분이 있기 때문에, 집권 1년 차에 탈당 문제를 이야기하는 것은 좀 나갔다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

In response, Chairman Lee Seok-yeon rebutted, "Claiming that a President leaving party affiliation violates the Constitution is, frankly, a case of the guilty accusing the innocent." (이에 대해 이석연 위원장은 “대통령이 당적을 이탈하는 것이 헌법에 어긋난다고 하는 건 그야말로 적반하장격 발언”이라며 반박했다.)

In a phone call that day, Lee said, "Our Constitution has no provisions whatsoever regarding the relationship between the President and party affiliation," adding, "Rather, the Constitution uses the expression 'head of state.' A head of state can be understood as representing the nation in a nonpartisan manner, transcending party affiliation." He continued, "Calling that 'ignorance of the Constitution' isn't even worth responding to," and "Making such ignorant statements and driving it forward with mob-style tactics is no different from the agitation politics of the old activist movement." Regarding the Democratic Party lawmakers criticizing his remarks, he said, "Their ignorance of the Constitution is significant. I'd like to offer constitutional education as a pro bono contribution." Lee served as the first constitutional research officer at the Constitutional Court and as Minister of Government Legislation under the Lee Myung-bak administration. (이 위원장은 이날 통화에서 “우리 헌법에는 대통령과 당적의 관계에 대해선 아무런 규정이 없다”면서 “오히려 대통령은 ‘국가 원수’라는 표현을 썼다. 국가 원수는 당적을 초월해 초당적으로 국가를 대표한다는 취지로 볼 수 있다”고 했다. 이어 “그런데 이걸 ‘헌법의 무지’라고 하는 것은 대꾸할 가치도 없는 일”이라며 “그런 무지한 이야기를 하고 세몰이 식으로 몰고가는 것은 과거 운동권의 선동정치나 다름이 없다”고 했다. 그러면서 자신의 발언을 비판하는 민주당 의원들에 대해 “헌법에 대한 무지가 크다. 재능 기부로 헌법 교육을 해주고 싶다”고 했다. 이 위원장은 헌법재판소에서 1호 헌법연구관으로 일했고, 이명박 정부 법제처장을 지냈다.)

Lee also claimed that Representative Kim Min-seok has been the one revealing "ignorance of the Constitution." He said, "As soon as (Kim) became Prime Minister, he said he would 'serve as the President's chief of staff,' but that's the job of the presidential chief of staff," adding, "The Prime Minister is a constitutional institution, so speaking that way shows an attitude of disregarding and belittling the Constitution." He also referenced Kim's remark during his tenure as Prime Minister that 'five years is too short' regarding President Lee's term, saying, "Conveying a hint that the President should serve another term is itself a disregard and belittlement of the Constitution." (이 위원장은 김민석 대표가 되려 ‘헌법에 대한 무지’를 드러내왔다고 말했다. 그는 “(김 대표는) 국무총리가 되자마자 ‘대통령 참모장 역할을 하겠다’고 했는데, 그건 대통령비서실장이 하는 일”이라며 “총리는 헌법기관인데, 총리가 그런 식으로 말하는 것은 헌법을 무시하고 경시하는 태도”라고 했다. 또 김 대표가 총리 시절 이 대통령 임기와 관련해 ‘5년이 너무 짧다’고 한 발언에 대해서도 “대통령을 한 번 더 해야 한다는 뉘앙스를 풍기는 것이야말로 헌법에 대한 무시이자 경시”라고 했다.)

item.title: Choi Min-hee and Lee Seong-yoon Push Back on Kim Min-seok's Nomination: "We Promised to Elect Them" (김민석 최고위원 지명에 최민희·이성윤 반기 “선출하기로 약속했잖나”)
item.description:
Choi Min-hee and Lee Seong-yoon Push Back on Kim Min-seok's Nomination: "We Promised to Elect Them" (김민석 최고위원 지명에 최민희·이성윤 반기 “선출하기로 약속했잖나”)

Choi Min-hee, senior supreme council member of the Democratic Party of Korea, publicly pushed back against party leader Kim Min-seok, saying, "If you suddenly reveal the list of nominees at a caucus meeting without even minimal consultation, can a proper resolution be passed?" She raised procedural concerns over Kim's disclosure of candidates for appointed supreme council seats at the general assembly of lawmakers on the 20th. (더불어민주당 최민희 수석최고위원이 김민석 대표를 향해 “최소한의 협의도 없이 의총에서 갑자기 지명자 명단을 공개해 버리면 제대로 의결이 되겠나”라며 공개적으로 반발했다. 김 대표가 20일 의원총회에서 지명직 최고위원 후보를 공개한 것에 대해 절차적 문제를 제기한 것이다.)

Lee Seong-yoon, a supreme council member also classified as part of the pro-Choi, pro-Myung faction along with Choi, wrote on Facebook the same day, "The party must of course uphold its highest norm, the party constitution. Even the party leader can never be an exception." He added, "I ask that appointments be made in accordance with party constitutional procedures, as befits the Democratic Party." (최 의원과 함께 친정청래계로 분류되는 이성윤 최고위원 역시 이날 페이스북에 “당은 당연히 최고규범 당헌을 지켜야 한다. 당대표도 결코 예외일 수 없다”면서 “민주당답게 당헌절차를 준수하여 임명해달라”고 했다.)

That day, at the general assembly of lawmakers, Kim announced that he would designate two-term lawmaker Jeon Yong-gi as the youth supreme council member and Kwon Mi-gyeong, chair of the Public Sector Solidarity Union Federation under the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions, for the labor quota. He also said, "If any member of the party affairs committee believes there are significant flaws in the process or content, I ask them to raise the issue at the party affairs meeting." (이날 김 대표는 의원총회에서 재선 전용기 의원을 청년 최고위원으로, 노동 몫으로는 권미경 한국노총 공공연대노동조합연맹 위원장을 지명하겠다고 밝혔다. 그러면서 김 대표는 “당무위원 중 절차나 내용에 큰 하자가 있다고 생각하면 당무회의에서 문제를 제기해 달라”고 했다.)

Explaining why he chose to appoint the supreme council members, Kim said, "I just heard the report. The conclusion of the report was that (electing the youth supreme council member) is not feasible. Since a new youth committee chair will soon be elected, if we also elect a youth supreme council member, the electorate and the elected would be exactly the same composition as the youth committee, creating significant redundancy in simultaneously electing a youth supreme council member." He added, "There is considerable contradiction in that." (김 대표는 지명직 최고위원을 하게 된 이유로 “조금 전 보고를 들었다. 보고의 결론은 (선출 방식 청년 최고위원은) 불가“라며 ”곧 청년위원장을 새로 뽑는데 청년 최고위원을 뽑는다면 뽑게 될 유권자와 똑같은 구성과 똑같은 피당선자가 청년위원회와 똑같은 중복적 청년 최고위원 선출을 동시에 하게 되기에 상당히 모순성이 있다”고 했다.)

The previous day, the 19th, at a supreme council meeting held in Busan, Choi had told Kim, "The recommendation of the party convention preparatory committee was to elect the youth supreme council member through democratic procedures." She added, "The previous leadership also elected the grassroots member supreme council member through a primary, so I hope you would take that into consideration." However, Kim decided on the youth supreme council member through his own nomination rather than a primary, and announced it that day. (전날인 19일 최 의원은 부산에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 김 대표에게 “민주적 절차를 거쳐 청년 최고위원을 선출했으면 좋겠다는 게 전대준비위 권고였다”며 “이전 지도부도 경선 방식으로 평당원 최고위원을 선출했으니 참고했으면 좋겠다”고 한 바 있다. 그런데 김 대표는 경선 방식이 아닌, 본인이 지명하는 방식으로 청년 최고위원을 정해 이날 발표한 것이다.)

Choi wrote on her Facebook that day, "I ask that you at least follow minimal procedures. During the party convention period, Representative Kim publicly promised to appoint the youth as an appointed supreme council member, and to use a festive, primary-style election method." She added, "How can you expect support from people in their 20s and 30s when you don't even keep the promises you publicly made to them?" (최 의원은 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “최소한의 절차를 지켜 주시기 바란다”며 “전당대회 기간에 김 대표께서는 청년을 지명직 최고위원으로 하겠다는 것, 선출방식을 축제 즉 경선방식으로 하겠다는 것을 공개적으로 약속했다”고 했다. 그러면서 “2030에게 공개적으로 한 약속 조차 지키지 않으면서 어떻게 2030의 지지를 받을 수 있겠나”라고도 했다.)

Choi further said, "Since there is a youth committee chair election, there is also the option of making the youth committee chair an ex-officio supreme council member, so I ask you to reconsider your decision." She added, "Deliberation can produce good solutions." (그러면서 최 의원은 “청년위원장 선거가 있으니 청년위원장을 당연직 최고위원으로 하는 방안도 있으니 결정을 재고해 주시기 바란다”며 “숙의는 좋은 해결책을 만들 수 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Ethics Committee Disciplines 4 Non-mainstream Lawmakers with Suspension of Party Rights (국힘 윤리위, 비당권파 4人 당원권 정지 징계)
item.description:
People Power Party Ethics Committee Disciplines 4 Non-mainstream Lawmakers with Suspension of Party Rights (국힘 윤리위, 비당권파 4人 당원권 정지 징계 )

The People Power Party's Central Ethics Committee announced on the 20th that it had decided to impose "suspension of party rights" discipline on lawmakers Cho Kyoung-tae, Seo Beom-soo, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh. The suspension periods are 2 years and 6 months for Cho Kyoung-tae, 2 years for Jin Jong-oh, 1 year and 6 months for Kwon Young-jin, and 10 months for Seo Beom-soo. In political circles, there is talk that "with the suspension of party rights discipline, these four lawmakers' nominations for the April 2028 general elections have become uncertain." (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회는 20일 조경태·서범수·권영진·진종오 의원에 대해 ‘당원권 정지’ 징계를 결정했다고 밝혔다. ‘당원권 정지’ 기간은 조경태 의원 2년 6개월, 진종오 의원 2년, 권영진 의원 1년 6개월, 서범수 의원 10개월이다. 정치권에서는 “당원권 정지 징계로 이들 네 의원의 2028년 4월 총선 공천이 불투명해졌다”는 말이 나왔다.)

The Party's Ethics Committee disclosed the results of the disciplinary actions against the four lawmakers in a press release on the same day. Regarding the grounds for disciplining Cho Kyoung-tae, the Ethics Committee stated, "After losing to lawmaker Park Duk-hyum in the intra-party primary held on May 13 to select the National Assembly Vice Speaker candidate allocated to the People Power Party, he sent the contents of a civic group's statement opposing Park Duk-hyum's candidacy via Telegram and text messages to a majority of lawmakers from other parties, including the Democratic Party of Korea, the New Reform Party, and the Progressive Party, and even called some lawmakers to ask them to work against Park Duk-hyum's election." It added, "This constitutes an act that defies party policy and undermines party order, and it was determined that the issues were not resolved even during the disciplined member's explanation process." (국민의힘 윤리위는 이날 보도자료에서 네 의원에 대한 징계 처분 결과를 공개했다. 윤리위는 조경태 의원의 징계 사유에 대해 “지난 5월 13일 국민의힘에 배정된 국회 부의장 후보 선출을 위한 당내 경선에서 박덕흠 의원에게 패한 후, 타 정당인 더불어민주당, 개혁신당, 진보당 소속 의원들 대다수에게 박덕흠 후보를 반대하는 시민단체의 성명서 내용을 텔레그램, 문자메시지로 전송하고, 일부 의원들에게는 전화로 박덕흠 의원의 낙선을 부탁했다”며 “이는 당론에 반하여 정당의 질서를 해하는 행위임에도 불구하고, 피징계자의 소명 과정에서도 문제점이 해소되지 않았다고 판단된다”고 했다.)

Regarding the grounds for disciplining Jin Jong-oh, the committee stated, "In connection with the Busan Buk-gu Gap National Assembly by-election held concurrently with the June 3 local elections, he publicly promoted and endorsed Han Dong-hoon, who had been expelled from the People Power Party and ran as an independent, through broadcasts and social media, and dispatched his own aides to a YouTube channel promoting Han Dong-hoon, thereby acting against party policy and undermining party order." It further stated, "Additionally, at a meeting on the 4th discussing the problems with abolishing supplementary investigative powers, when lawmaker Seo Beom-soo made the remark 'Let's do one spin-kick,' Jin responded inappropriately, saying 'I'm better with my hands than my feet,' which tarnished the party's honor and ran counter to public sentiment." (진종오 의원의 징계 사유에 대해서는 “6·3 지방선거와 동시에 실시된 부산 북구갑 국회의원 보궐선거와 관련하여, 국민의힘에서 제명된 후 무소속으로 입후보한 한동훈을 방송 및 소셜미디어를 통해 공개적으로 홍보 및 지지하고, 한동훈을 홍보하는 유튜브 채널에 자신의 보좌진을 파견하는 등 당론에 반하여 당의 질서를 해하는 행위를 했다”고 했다. 이어 “진 의원은 또한 지난 4일 보완수사권 폐지의 문제점을 토의하는 간담회에서 ‘돌려차기 한 번 하죠’라는 서범수 의원의 발언에 대하여 ‘저는 발보다는 손을 잘 씁니다’라는 부적절한 답변을 함으로써 당의 명예를 실추시키고 국민의 정서에 반하는 행위를 했다”고 밝혔다.)

Regarding the grounds for disciplining Kwon Young-jin, the committee stated, "On July 23, while protesting the results of the allocation of standing committees for the second half of the 22nd National Assembly to floor leader Chung Jin-suk at the floor leader's office in the main building of the National Assembly, he grabbed Chung Jin-suk by the collar and shouted, using physical force." It added, "Although the disciplined member later formally apologized to floor leader Chung Jin-suk and expressed remorse, such use of physical force constitutes conduct unbecoming of a lawmaker and an act that tarnishes the party's honor and prestige." (권영진 의원 징계 사유에 대해서는 “지난 7월 23일 국회 본관 원내대표실에서 정점식 원내대표를 상대로 제22대 국회 후반기 상임위원회 배분 결과에 항의하던 중 정점식 원내대표의 멱살을 잡고 고성을 지르는 등 물리력을 행사했다”며 “이후 피징계자가 정점식 원내대표에게 공식적으로 사과하고 잘못을 반성하였으나, 위와 같은 물리력 행사는 국회의원으로서의 품위를 저버린 행위로서 당의 명예와 위신을 실추시킨 행위에 해당한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the grounds for disciplining Seo Beom-soo, the committee stated, "At a meeting on the 4th discussing the problems with abolishing supplementary investigative powers, he said to lawmaker Jin Jong-oh, 'Let's do one spin-kick,' to which Jin Jong-oh replied, 'I'm better with my hands than my feet.'" It added, "The disciplined member's conduct was an inappropriate remark that could be seen as trivializing the suffering of the victim of the 'Busan spin-kick incident,' thereby tarnishing the party's honor and running counter to public sentiment." (서범수 의원 징계 사유에 대해서는 “지난 4일 보완수사권 폐지의 문제점을 토의하는 간담회에서 진종오 의원에게 ‘돌려차기 한 번 하죠’라고 발언했고, 이에 대해 진종오 의원은 ‘저는 발보다는 손을 잘 씁니다’라고 답변했다”며 “피징계자의 행위는 ‘부산 돌려차기 사건’ 피해자의 고통을 가볍게 여기는 것으로 보일 수 있는 부적절한 발언으로서 당의 명예를 실추시키고 국민의 정서에 반하는 행위에 해당한다”고 했다.)

item.title: South Korean PM Orders "Best Efforts in Search for Missing Woman in Jeju... Strict Response to Secondary Harm" (韓총리 “제주 실종 여성 수색에 최선… 2차 가해 엄정 대응하라” 지시)
item.description:
South Korean PM Orders "Best Efforts in Search for Missing Woman in Jeju... Strict Response to Secondary Harm" (韓총리 “제주 실종 여성 수색에 최선… 2차 가해 엄정 대응하라” 지시)

Prime Minister Han Sung-sook issued instructions to police on the 20th regarding the long-term disappearance of a woman in her 30s in Jeju, stating, "Do your utmost in the search for the missing person and respond strictly to acts of secondary harm against the missing person's family." It is unusual for a prime minister to give specific instructions to related agencies regarding an adult disappearance case. (한성숙 국무총리가 제주에서 일어난 30대 여성 장기 실종 사건과 관련해 20일 경찰에 “실종자 수색에 최선을 다하고, 실종자 가족에 대한 2차 가해 행위에 엄정 대응하라”고 지시했다. 총리가 성인 실종 사건에 대해 관계 기관에 구체적으로 지시를 내리는 것은 이례적이다.)

According to the Office of the Prime Minister, Han gave these instructions after seeing reports that prank calls were being made to the family of missing person Jang Mi-ran (37). Han stated, "Acts such as making prank calls to the victim's family, who are desperately searching for their missing loved one, or spreading fake news can never be tolerated," and added, "Respond strictly to such acts of secondary harm in accordance with the law and principles." (국무총리실에 따르면, 한 총리는 이날 오전 장미란(37)씨 실종 사건과 관련해 실종자 가족에게 장난 전화가 걸려오고 있다는 보도를 접하고 이같이 지시했다. 한 총리는 “애타는 마음으로 (실종된) 가족을 찾고 있는 피해 가족에게 장난 전화를 걸거나 가짜 뉴스를 유포하는 등의 행위는 결코 용납될 수 없다”며 “이러한 2차 가해 행위에 대해 법과 원칙에 따라 엄정히 대응하라”고 했다.)

Jang, a resident of Hallim-eup in Jeju, went missing after leaving her home between late afternoon on May 12th and dawn on May 13th. Her family reported her absence to police on May 15th, stating she had not returned home, but A, an officer at the rank of Senior Constable on duty at the time, reported to his superior that "contact had been made with the person reported missing" and closed the case on the day the report was filed. However, Jang never returned, and her mobile phone was turned off on May 16th. (제주 한림읍에 사는 장씨는 지난 5월 12일 늦은 오후에서 13일 새벽 사이에 집을 나선 뒤 실종됐다. 가족은 지난 5월 15일 장씨가 귀가하지 않는다며 경찰에 신고했지만, 당시 근무자였던 A 경장은 “신고 대상자와 연락이 닿았다”는 취지로 상관에게 보고하고, 신고 접수 당일에 사건을 종결 처리했다. 그러나 장씨는 돌아오지 않았고, 장씨 휴대전화는 5월 16일 꺼졌다.)

Jang's family filed another report with police on July 19th, and police belatedly launched a reinvestigation, but by then more than two months had passed, and all CCTV footage and other evidence had been deleted. When police reviewed the call records of Jang's phone, they found no records of calls with A or the police station where he worked, and police charged A with abandonment of duty. (장씨 가족은 지난 7월 19일 경찰에 다시 신고했고, 경찰이 뒤늦게 재수사에 돌입했으나 시간이 2개월 이상 지나 방범 카메라(CCTV) 영상 등이 모두 삭제된 뒤였다. 경찰이 장씨 휴대전화의 통화 기록을 조회해 보니 A 경장이나 그가 근무했던 경찰서와 통화한 기록은 나오지 않았고, 경찰은 A 경장을 직무 유기 혐의로 입건했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon on disciplinary action against four anti-Jang Dong-hyuk lawmakers: "If the party is turned into a private tool, it will be abandoned by the people" (反장동혁 4인 징계에... 한동훈 “사당화, 국민께 버림받을 것”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon on disciplinary action against four anti-Jang Dong-hyuk lawmakers: "If the party is turned into a private tool, it will be abandoned by the people" (反장동혁 4인 징계에... 한동훈 “사당화, 국민께 버림받을 것”)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon on the 20th criticized the People Power Party's ethics committee for imposing disciplinary action en masse against lawmakers Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, Seo Beom-su, and Jin Jong-oh, saying, "If a public party is turned into a private tool, it will be abandoned by the people." The four lawmakers subjected to disciplinary measures that day had been openly criticizing the leadership of party leader Jang Dong-hyuk. Han had also been expelled from the party in January by the People Power Party's ethics committee in connection with the "party member bulletin board incident." (무소속 한동훈 의원은 20일 국민의힘 윤리위원회가 조경태·권영진·서범수·진종오 의원을 무더기 징계한 데 대해 “공당(公黨)을 사당화(私黨化)하면 국민께 버림받게 될 것”이라고 비판했다. 이날 징계 조치가 내려진 의원 4명은 그간 장동혁 대표의 노선을 공개적으로 비판해왔다. 한 의원 또한 지난 1월 국민의힘 윤리위에서 ‘당원 게시판 사건’과 관련해 제명당한 바 있다.)

As the ethics committee imposed heavy disciplinary action on non-mainstream lawmakers, Han stated that day, "Selective and arbitrary disciplinary politics aimed at turning a public party into a private tool continues," adding, "If the opposition party is reduced to a private tool, it cannot stop Lee Jae-myung's (presidential) bid for extended dictatorship." (한 의원은 이날 윤리위가 국민의힘 비당권파 의원들을 중징계하자 “공당을 사당화하기 위한 선택적이고 자의적인 징계 정치가 계속되고 있다”면서 이같이 밝혔다. 또 그는 “야당이 사당화되면 이재명 (대통령의) 연임 독재를 못 막는다”고도 했다.)

The lawmakers subjected to disciplinary measures also pushed back in unison. Lawmaker Kwon Young-jin said in a statement, "As expected, the ethics committee was nothing more than a faithful hunting dog for the Jang Dong-hyuk faction," and fiercely protested, "This disciplinary action is tantamount to telling me to effectively quit politics in this party where I have shared 27 years of glory and hardship together—it is political terrorism." He added, "I will wear the punishment from the Jang Dong-hyuk faction as a badge of honor and fight even more boldly from now on," and "I will inform the public and party members of the party's privatization and its misguided management, and step forward with greater courage to correct it." (이날 징계 조치가 내려진 의원들도 일제히 반발했다. 권영진 의원은 입장문에서 “역시나 윤리위원회는 장동혁 당권파의 충실한 사냥개였다”며 “이번 징계는 지난 27년 동안 영욕을 함께하며 지켜온 이 당에서 사실상 정치를 접으라는 것과 다름없는 정치적 테러”라고 강하게 반발했다. 그러면서 “저는 장동혁 당권파로부터 받은 징계를 훈장으로 삼아 이제부터 더 당당하게 싸울 것”이라며 “당의 사당화와 잘못된 운영 행태를 국민과 당원들께 알리고, 이를 바로잡는 일에 더 용기 있게 나서겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the ethics committee's decision to impose a heavy penalty of suspending party membership rights for one year and six months, he criticized, "The hearing process was nothing more than a formality; it was an unfair 'fixed outcome' where the answer was already determined under someone's orders and procedures were merely gone through," calling it "a vile politically retaliatory punishment designed to silence and take revenge on lawmakers who criticize the Jang Dong-hyuk faction." (또 당원권 정지 1년 6개월이라는 윤리위의 중징계 결정 과정에 대해 “소명 절차는 요식행위에 불과했고, 이미 누군가의 지시에 따라 답을 정해 놓고 절차만 거친 ‘불공정한 답정너(답은 정해져 있다는 뜻)’였다”며 “장동혁 당권파를 비판하는 의원들의 입을 틀어막고, 보복하기 위한 비열한 정치 보복성 징계”라고 비판했다.)

Lawmaker Seo Beom-su, who received a 10-month suspension of party membership rights, also apologized for careless remarks that were inappropriate for the situation, but said, "I hope this ethics committee decision was not a fixed-outcome punishment aimed at eliminating political opponents." (당원권 정지 10개월 징계가 내려진 서범수 의원 또한 상황에 맞지 않는 경솔한 언행에 대해 사과하면서도 “이번 윤리위 판단이 정적을 제거하는 답정너식 징계가 아니었기를 바란다”고 했다.)

Earlier, the People Power Party's ethics committee decided to suspend party membership rights for lawmakers Cho Kyung-tae (2 years and 6 months), Kwon Young-jin (1 year and 6 months), Seo Beom-su (10 months), and Jin Jong-oh (2 years). With this disciplinary action, the prospects for these four lawmakers' nominations in the April 2028 general election have become uncertain. (앞서 국민의힘 윤리위는 조경태(2년 6개월), 권영진(1년 6개월), 서범수(10개월), 진종오(2년) 의원에 대해 당원권 정지 징계를 결정했다. 이번 징계로 이들 4명 의원의 2028년 4월 총선 공천이 불투명해졌다.)

Lawmaker Cho Kyung-tae had been referred to the ethics committee for appealing to lawmakers of other parties to campaign for the defeat of People Power Party Deputy National Assembly Speaker Park Deok-heum. (조경태 의원은 다른 당 의원들에게 국민의힘 박덕흠 국회부의장의 낙선을 호소했다는 이유로 윤리위에 제소된 바 있다.)

In the case of Kwon Young-jin, he was subject to disciplinary action for grabbing the collar of floor leader Chung Jin-suk while protesting the process of committee assignments in the National Assembly. Pro-Han (Han Dong-hoon faction) lawmakers Seo Beom-su and Jin Jong-oh faced disciplinary action over inappropriate remarks made at a forum where the victim of the "Busan spinning kick" case was invited. Jin was also referred to the ethics committee for supporting independent candidate Han Dong-hoon in the June 3 Busan Buk-gap by-election. (권영진 의원의 경우, 국회 상임위원회 배정 과정에 항의하면서 정점식 원내대표의 멱살을 잡아 징계 대상에 올랐다. 친한계(한동훈계)인 서범수·진종오 의원은 ‘부산 돌려차기’ 사건 피해자를 초청한 토론회에서의 부적절한 발언이 징계 사유가 됐다. 진 의원은 6·3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 무소속 한동훈 후보를 지원한 점도 윤리위 회부 사유로 꼽혔다.)

Political circles are analyzing that the disciplinary action against the four non-mainstream lawmakers could amplify internal party conflict. A member of the People Power Party aligned with Han said, "So far, the ethics committee's disciplinary actions have been applied only to Han Dong-hoon, lawmaker Bae Hyun-jin, and former supreme council member Kim Jong-hyuk, whom leader Jang Dong-hyuk harbored animosity toward," and added, "The four lawmakers punished this time are also, coincidentally, all critical of the leadership faction—so who would trust the ethics committee's fairness?" Indeed, that day the ethics committee did not impose any disciplinary action on leadership-faction supreme council member Jo Kwang-han or media spokesperson Park Min-young, who had been referred over controversies involving harsh language. (정치권에선 비당권파 의원 4명의 징계를 계기로 당내 갈등이 증폭될 수 있다는 분석이 나온다. 국민의힘 한 의원은 “그간 윤리위 징계는 오로지 장동혁 대표가 적개심을 품었던 한동훈·배현진 의원, 김종혁 전 최고위원에게만 적용됐다”며 “이번에 징계 조치가 내려진 네 의원도 공교롭게도 모조리 당권파에 비판적인 인사들이니 윤리위의 공정성을 누가 믿겠나”라고 했다. 실제 이날 윤리위는 막말 논란으로 제소된 당권파 조광한 최고위원, 박민영 미디어 대변인 등에 대한 징계는 내리지 않았다.)

item.title: Kim Yo-jong: "Lee Jae-myung, Unable to Protest a Word from Trump, Instead Flatters Him" (김여정 “트럼프 말 한마디에 항변 못하고 아첨하는 이재명”)
item.description:
Kim Yo-jong: "Lee Jae-myung, Unable to Protest a Word from Trump, Instead Flatters Him" (김여정 “트럼프 말 한마디에 항변 못하고 아첨하는 이재명”)

Kim Yo-jong, vice department director of North Korea's Workers' Party, said on the 20th, "With just one word from Trump ordering a sudden reduction of exercises, Seoul has been put in the pitiful position of having to pack up its favorite 'war games' arena." (북한의 김여정 노동당 부장은 20일 “돌연 훈련 축소를 지시한 트럼프의 말 한마디에 서울은 제일 즐겨 하던 ‘전쟁놀이’판을 거두어야 하는 가긍한 처지에 놓이게 되였다”고 했다.)

In a statement to the South released through the Korean Central News Agency, Kim Yo-jong said, "As soon as the large-scale invasion war drill between the U.S. and South Korea, 'Ulchi Freedom Guardian,' began on Korean soil, it was met with a cold shower," adding, "Being unable to protest even a single word when U.S. forces tuck their tails in, without any mutual coordination, under the unilateral order of the U.S. commander-in-chief—that is the fate of a puppet army that has handed over its command authority to its master." (김여정은 조선중앙통신을 통해 발표한 대남 담화에서 “한국 땅에서 벌어지는 미·한의 대규모 침략 전쟁 시연인 ‘을지 프리덤 가디언’이 시작되자마자 된서리를 맞았다”며 “미 통수권자의 일방적인 지령에 따라 쌍방 간 조율도 없이 미군이 꼬리를 사려도 항변 한마디 할 수 없는 것이 바로 지휘권을 상전에게 맡긴 허수아비 군대의 숙명”이라고 했다.)

Kim Yo-jong stated, "For South Korea, this is likely the first 'unprecedented incident' where, without any prior discussion, the exercise was cut short at the spur of the moment, becoming a half-baked drill with its torso severed, an empty shell with the yolk removed." She also took aim at President Lee Jae-myung, saying, "In front, Lee Jae-myung flatters Trump with sycophantic remarks about expressing 'respect' for the 'decision to reduce exercises' and calling it a 'significant decision born of deep deliberation,' but behind his back, he talks about 'self-reliant defense' and 'securing independent military capabilities' to prepare for a 'worst-case scenario.' This two-faced behavior of Lee Jae-myung perfectly reveals South Korea's anxious and contradictory mindset." (김여정은 “한국에 있어서 이번처럼 사전 논의도 없이 시작되자 창졸간에 몸통이 잘린 반쪽짜리 연습, 노른자위가 빠진 빈껍데기 연습으로 되기는 사상 처음 있는 ‘변고’일 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 이재명 대통령을 향해 “앞에서는 트럼프의 ‘연습 축소 결정’에 ‘경의’를 표한다느니, ‘고심이 담긴 큰 결정’이라느니 하는 낯간지러운 소리로 아첨하고 뒤에 돌아앉아서는 ‘최악의 시나리오’에 대비한 ‘자주 국방’과 ‘독자적인 군사력 확보’를 운운한 이재명의 안팎이 다른 이중적 행위는 한국의 불안 초조한 모순 심리를 그대로 보여주고 있다”고 했다.)

Kim Yo-jong said, "A country whose entire national security is shaken by a mere reduction of one joint military exercise is the true reality of South Korea, which entrusts its defense and security to foreign powers while boasting that it has 'more than enough capability to protect itself,'" adding, "The predicament of South Korea, left sulking because it can no longer play its favorite 'war games,' vividly illustrates the master-subordinate structure of the so-called 'U.S.-South Korea blood alliance' they pride themselves on." She further said, "Seoul's ruling elites, trying to cover up their embarrassing position of being slighted by their master, are making excuses about a 'moment for transitioning to a new phase' or a 'new starting point for bringing about a change in relations,' but anyone can see these are nothing but shabby justifications." (김여정은 “단 한 번의 합동 군사 연습 축소로 국가 안보가 통째로 흔들리는 나라가 바로 국방과 안보를 외세에 내맡기고도 ‘스스로를 지킬 능력이 차고 넘친다’고 자평하는 한국이라는 실체”라며 “제일 하고 싶던 ‘전쟁놀이’를 못하게 되여 시르죽은 꼴이 된 한국의 처지는 그들이 자랑하던 ‘미·한 혈맹’의 주종 관계 구도를 선명히 그려주고 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “서울 위정자들이 상전의 무시를 당한 저들의 민망스러운 처지를 가리워보려고 그 무슨 ‘새로운 국면으로의 전환 계기’니 ‘관계 변화를 가져올 수 있는 새로운 단초’니 하며 딴전을 피우고 있지만 누가 보아도 궁색한 변명이 아닐 수 없다”고도 했다.)

Kim Yo-jong's statement to the South on this day came amid a growing mood in our government hoping for a resumption of North Korea-U.S. dialogue following the reduction of the South Korea-U.S. joint exercises. Analysts say it carries the intent of preemptively blocking our government's expectations that resuming North Korea-U.S. talks could lead to improved inter-Korean relations. Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Kyungnam University's Institute for Far Eastern Studies, said, "This is a clear rejection of the current within the South Korean government to use the exercise reduction as a 'starting point' for reopening inter-Korean dialogue or shifting the situation," adding, "It signals that North Korea's strategic dialogue partner is only the United States, and it will not tolerate the South Korean government taking on the role of mediator or facilitator in between." (김여정의 이날 대남 담화는 한미 연합 훈련 축소를 계기로 우리 정부가 북미 대화 재개를 희망하는 분위기가 커지는 와중에 나온 것이다. 북미 대화 재개를 통해 남북 관계 개선까지 이어지길 바라는 우리 정부 기대를 사전에 차단하고 나선 의도가 깔려 있다는 분석이다. 임을출 경남대 극동문제연구소 교수는 “한국 정부가 연합훈련 축소를 계기로 남북 간 대화 재개나 정세 전환의 ‘단초’를 마련하려는 기류에 대해 명확한 거부 의사를 밝힌 것”이라며 “북한의 전략적 대화 상대는 오직 미국이며 한국 정부가 중간에서 중개자나 촉진자 역할을 자처하는 것을 용납하지 않겠다는 입장”이라고 했다.)

The explicit rhetoric mocking President Lee's remarks and disparaging the South Korea-U.S. alliance appears intended to exploit recent discord between Seoul and Washington and the domestic push for wartime operational control transfer, aiming to drive a wedge into the alliance. Yang Moo-jin, a distinguished professor at the University of North Korean Studies, said, "This is a statement designed to build justification for bypassing South Korea in the North Korea-U.S. dialogue process," and "it is an attempt to sow discord and create a rift in South Korea-U.S. relations by riding on President Trump's expressed disappointment with President Lee." Yang added, "Mentioning our president by name and using mocking insults like 'master' and 'puppet' is a strategic move to steer North Korea-U.S. talks into a bilateral framework (excluding South Korea) within a two-state structure." (노골적 언사로 이 대통령 발언을 비꼬고 한미 동맹을 폄훼한 것은 최근 한미 간 엇박자, 전작권 전환이 추진되는 국내 상황 등을 염두에 두고 한미 동맹 균열을 의도한 것으로 보인다. 양무진 북한대학원대학교 석좌교수는 “북미대화 과정에서 한국을 패싱하기 위한 명분 축적용 담화”라며 “트럼프 대통령의 이 대통령에 대한 실망감 제기에 편승한 한미관계 이간 및 균열시도”라고 했다. 양 교수는 “우리 대통령 실명을 거론하고 상전·괴뢰 등 조롱성 비난을 한 것은 2국가 구도속에서 북미대화를 (남한이 빠진)양자구도로 이끌어가기 위한 포석”이라고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 19th, President Lee Jae-myung had said regarding Trump's decision to reduce South Korea-U.S. joint exercises, "I empathize with President Trump's will and efforts to create conditions for dialogue to build a peace regime on the Korean Peninsula, and I express my respect for his decision," adding, "I hope this decision by President Trump leads to trust-building between North Korea and the U.S. and the resumption of dialogue, ultimately establishing a stable peace regime on the Korean Peninsula." (앞서 이재명 대통령은 19일 트럼프의 한미 연합 훈련 축소 결정에 대해 “한반도에서 평화 체제 구축을 위한 대화 여건을 조성하려는 트럼프 대통령님의 의지와 노력에 공감하며 그 결단에 경의를 표한다”며 “트럼프 대통령님의 이 결단이 북미 간 신뢰 구축과 대화 재개를 거쳐 한반도의 안정적 평화 체제 구축으로 이어지기를 기대한다”고 했었다.)

item.title: China Singles Out Lawmakers Who Visited Taiwan for Entry Denial (中, 대만 다녀온 의원들 콕 집어 입국 거부)
item.description:
China Singles Out Lawmakers Who Visited Taiwan for Entry Denial (中, 대만 다녀온 의원들 콕 집어 입국 거부)

It was confirmed on the 20th that, during the National Assembly's push to visit China this month, the Chinese Embassy in Seoul conveyed a position demanding that specific lawmakers be excluded from the delegation. The lawmakers denied the visit had traveled to Taiwan earlier this year as part of parliamentary diplomacy. (국회가 이달 중국 방문을 추진하는 과정에서 주한중국대사관이 특정 의원을 방문단에서 제외하라는 입장을 전달한 것으로 20일 확인됐다. 방문을 거절당한 의원들은 올해 의원외교 차원에서 대만을 찾았었다.)

According to National Assembly officials and others, 15 lawmakers from both ruling and opposition parties on the National Assembly's Environment and Labor Committee for Climate and Energy planned to visit Beijing, China, for a four-day, three-night schedule starting on the 19th. The plan included attending the World Robot Conference (WRC), China's largest robotics event, and meeting with Chinese government officials. Lawmakers hold official passports and do not need separate visas for visits to China, but they had discussed the visit schedule with the Chinese government. (국회 관계자 등에 따르면 국회 기후에너지환경노동위원회 여야 의원 15명은 지난 19일부터 3박 4일간 일정으로 중국 베이징을 방문할 계획이었다. 중국 최대 로봇 행사인 월드로봇컨퍼런스(WRC)를 참관하고 중국 정부 인사를 만난다는 계획이었다. 국회의원은 관용여권이 있어 중국 방문 때 별도의 비자 발급은 필요 없지만, 중국 정부와 방문 일정을 논의했다.)

However, the Chinese Embassy in Seoul reportedly notified the National Assembly earlier this month to "remove" Rep. Kim Gi-hyeon (People Power Party, Ulsan Nam-eul) and Rep. Kwak Sang-eon (Democratic Party of Korea, Seoul Jongno) from the delegation list. Subsequently, issues such as flight arrangements arose, and the committee-level plan to visit China was canceled. (그런데 주한중국대사관은 이달초 국민의힘 김기현(울산 남을) 의원과 더불어민주당 곽상언(서울 종로) 의원에 대해 “방중 명단에서 빼달라”고 국회에 통보했다고 한다. 이후 항공편 문제 등이 겹치면서 상임위 차원의 방중 계획은 취소됐다.)

A National Assembly official said, "We did not hear the exact reason, and the two were only told that visiting China would be difficult." The two lawmakers, whom China effectively refused entry, had visited Taiwan this year. Rep. Kim Gi-hyeon visited Taiwan early this year for a three-day, two-night trip as chairman of the National Assembly's Asia Human Rights Parliamentarians' Alliance, meeting with Taiwan's Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung and others. Rep. Kwak visited Taiwan in June, meeting with Deputy Foreign Minister Wu Chih-chung and others, expressing welcome for strengthened exchanges between the capitals of South Korea and Taiwan. At the time, the Chinese government cited the "One China" principle and objected to the diplomatic visits by Rep. Kwak and others to Taiwan. (국회 관계자는 “정확한 사유는 듣지 못했고, 두 사람은 방중이 어렵다는 취지만 전달받았다”고 했다. 중국이 사실상 방문을 거부한 두 의원은 올해 대만을 방문했다. 김기현 의원은 올 초 국회 아시아인권의원연맹 회장 자격으로 2박 3일간 대만을 찾아 린자룽 대만 외교부장 등과 만났다. 곽 의원은 지난 6월 대만을 찾아 우즈중 정무차장(차관) 등을 만나 한국과 대만의 수도 간 교류 강화를 환영한다는 입장을 밝혔다. 당시 중국 정부는 ‘하나의 중국’을 거론하며 곽 의원 등의 대만 방문 외교에 반발했다.)

South Korea suspended official diplomatic relations with Taiwan upon establishing ties with China, but has since maintained representative offices and continued personnel and economic exchanges. A Korea-Taiwan parliamentary friendship association is conducting exchanges, and some lawmakers who have visited Taiwan and met with Taiwanese officials have also recently traveled to China. In diplomatic circles, there is talk that "it seems like they are trying to deter lawmakers' exchanges with Taiwan by creating cases of entry denial, like killing a chicken to scare the monkey." (한국은 중국과 수교하면서 대만과의 공식 외교 관계는 중단했지만 이후에도 대표부를 두고 인적·경제적 교류를 이어가고 있다. 한·대만 국회의원 우호협회가 교류를 진행 중이고, 대만을 방문해 당국자를 만났던 의원 중엔 최근에도 중국을 다녀온 경우도 있다. 외교가에선 “닭을 죽여 원숭이를 겁준다는 말처럼 일부 입국 거부 사례를 만들어 의원들의 대만 교류를 막으려는 것 같다”는 말이 나왔다.)

Rep. Kim told this newspaper in a phone call, "This was not a personal schedule but official parliamentary activity at the committee level, and the Chinese government stepped in to block it." Rep. Kwak said, "The Chinese government intends to evaluate and interfere with the parliamentary activities of South Korean lawmakers one by one." Rep. Kwak also sent a protest letter to the Chinese Embassy in Seoul but reportedly received no response. The Chinese Embassy in Seoul told this newspaper, "We have no comment to offer." (김 의원은 본지 통화에서 “개인 일정도 아니고 국회 상임위 차원의 공식적인 의정 활동을 중국 정부가 나서서 막은 것”이라고 했다. 곽 의원은 “중국 정부가 대한민국 국회의원의 의정 활동을 하나하나 평가해 간섭하겠다는 것”이라고 했다. 곽 의원은 주한중국대사관에 항의 서한도 전달했지만 답변은 받지 못했다고 한다. 주한중국대사관 측은 본지에 “드릴 답변이 없다”고 했다.)

China also denied entry to lawmakers by refusing visa issuance back in 2002. At that time, Rep. Choi Yong-kyu of the Democratic Party and Rep. Hwang Woo-yea of the Grand National Party applied for Chinese entry visas, but China refused them. In 2004, 10 lawmakers from the then-Grand National Party attempted to visit China to inspect Goguryeo historical sites, but the Chinese government delayed visa issuance and only granted them after receiving protests. It was known to be a protest against some lawmakers attending the inauguration of Taiwanese President Chen Shui-bian at the time. In 2012, China refused to issue a visa to Rep. Park Sun-young of the Liberty Forward Party, who had been campaigning against the forced repatriation of North Korean defectors. (중국은 지난 2002년에도 국회의원의 비자 발급을 거부하며 입국을 막았었다. 당시 민주당 최용규 의원과 한나라당 황우여 의원 등은 중국 입국 비자 신청을 했으나 중국은 이를 거부했다. 2004년에는 당시 한나라당 의원 10명이 고구려사 유적지 답사를 이유로 중국을 방문하려 했으나 중국 정부는 비자 발급을 미루다 항의를 받고서야 뒤늦게 내줬다. 당시 대만 천수이볜 총통 취임식에 일부 의원이 참석한 것에 대한 항의였던 것으로 알려졌다. 2012년에는 탈북자 강제 북송 반대 운동을 벌이던 자유선진당 박선영 의원의 비자 발급을 거부했다.)

item.title: Defense Ministry, After Years of Denial... "North Korea Deploys 600mm Super-Large Multiple Rocket Launchers to Front Lines" (국방부, 여태 부인하더니... “北 600㎜ 초대형방사포 전방 배치”)
item.description:
Defense Ministry, After Years of Denial... "North Korea Deploys 600mm Super-Large Multiple Rocket Launchers to Front Lines" (국방부, 여태 부인하더니... “北 600㎜ 초대형방사포 전방 배치”)

The Ministry of National Defense officially confirmed for the first time on the 20th, during its report to the National Assembly's Defense Committee, that North Korea's 600mm super-large multiple rocket launchers have been deployed to the front lines. With a range of around 400km, the 600mm super-large multiple rocket launchers, if deployed near the Military Demarcation Line, would bring the entire Korean mainland—excluding island areas—within striking distance. Up until the first half of this year, the Defense Ministry had maintained that there were no signs of operational deployment. (국방부가 20일 국회 국방위 업무보고에서 처음으로 북한 600㎜ 초대형 방사포의 전방배치를 공식 확인했다. 600㎜ 초대형 방사포는 사거리가 400㎞ 안팎으로 휴전선 인근 배치시 도서지역을 제외한 한반도 본토 전역이 사정권에 들어간다. 올 상반기까지 국방부는 실전배치 동향이 없다고 주장해왔다.)

In its report that day, the Defense Ministry stated, "The North Korean military is strengthening its military capabilities by deploying new weapons systems, including new 240mm and 600mm multiple rocket launchers, self-propelled artillery, and tactical missiles, to border areas." Among these, the 600mm super-large multiple rocket launcher is a short-range ballistic missile that North Korea claims can carry the tactical nuclear warhead 'Hwasan-31,' unveiled in 2023. Whether it can actually carry a nuclear warhead has not been confirmed, but military intelligence authorities are known to believe it "may be possible." (국방부는 이날 업무보고에서 “북한군은 신형 240㎜·600㎜ 방사포와 자주포, 전술미사일 등 신규 무기체계를 접경지역에 배치하며 군사력을 증강 중”이라고 밝혔다. 이 가운데 600㎜ 초대형 방사포는 북한이 2023년 공개한 전술 핵탄두 ‘화산-31’을 탑재할 수 있다고 주장하는 단거리 탄도미사일이다. 실제 핵탄두 탑재 가능 여부는 확인되지 않았지만 군 정보당국은 “가능할 수 있다”고 보고 있는 것으로 알려졌다.)

In February, ahead of the Workers' Party's 9th Congress, North Korea unveiled dozens of improved 600mm super-large multiple rocket launchers mounted with five launch tubes each, and North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un, while reviewing the launchers, called them "super-powerful attack weapons" "also suited for carrying out strategic missions." In response to a question from People Power Party lawmaker Kang Dae-sik in March, the Defense Ministry said, "It is estimated that North Korea has produced a total of around 80 transporter-erector-launchers (TELs) for the 600mm super-large multiple rocket launchers to date." However, at that time, the Defense Ministry stated, "We assess that they have not yet been deployed for operational (combat) use." (북한은 지난 2월 노동당 제9차 대회를 앞두고 발사관 5개가 탑재된 개량형 600㎜ 초대형 방사포 수십 문을 공개했고, 김정은 북한 국무위원장은 방사포를 사열하며 “전략적인 사명수행에도 적합화”된 “초강력 공격무기”라고 했다. 이와 관련 국방부는 지난 3월 국민의힘 강대식 의원 질의에 “현재까지 북한의 600㎜ 초대형 방사포 이동식 발사 차량(TEL)은 총 80여 기를 생산한 것으로 추정된다”고 했다. 하지만 당시 국방부는 “아직까지 작전(실전) 배치는 되지 않은 것으로 판단하고 있다”고 했다.)

Shin Jong-woo, secretary general of the Korea Defense and Security Forum, said, "Within the span of six months, North Korea may have deployed front-line rocket launchers capable of carrying tactical nuclear warheads, or the Defense Ministry may have obtained intelligence and chosen not to disclose it," adding, "Assuming around 80 units have been produced, North Korea could fire over 400 rocket rounds in succession, loading some with tactical nuclear warheads and using a 'mixed-fire' approach to overload the South Korea-U.S. air defense network." (신종우 한국국방안보포럼 사무총장은 “반년 사이에 북한이 전방에 전술핵 탑재 가능한 방사포를 배치했거나, 국방부가 첩보를 입수하고도 밝히지 않았을 수 있다”며 “80여대가 생산됐다는 가정하에 북한은 400여발이 넘는 방사포탄을 연달아 발사하며 일부에 전술핵을 탑재해 ‘섞어쏘기’로 한·미 방공망에 과부하를 유도할 것”이라고 했다.)

The military predicted that North Korea's border fortification work along the Military Demarcation Line (MDL), which began in April 2024 after Kim Jong-un declared inter-Korean relations as those between "two hostile states" in December 2023, would be completed around 2028. Of the 250km MDL, work on barren terrain is about 90% complete, while the installation of barbed wire fences and minefields is 30–60% underway. (2023년 12월 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 남북관계를 ‘적대적 두 국가’로 선언한 이후 2024년 4월부터 시작된 북한의 군사분계선(MDL) 일대 국경선화 작업은 2028년쯤 마무리될 것으로 군은 예상했다. MDL 250㎞ 중 불모지 작업은 약 90% 완성됐고, 철책·지뢰지대 설치 작업은 30~60%가량 진행됐다는 것이다.)

The Defense Ministry stated, "We are responding in an integrated and systematic manner to North Korea's so-called 'border fortress' push, including the installation of obstacles along the MDL and the reinforcement of military forces in border areas." It said it would strengthen counterfire capabilities and surveillance posture by bolstering division-level counter-artillery radars, the 'Chunmoo' multiple rocket launcher system, integrated anti-drone systems, and AI-based scientific sentry systems. However, upgrades to the GOP (General Outpost) scientific sentry system are known to be only around 2040 before completion. (국방부는 “북한의 MDL 일대 장애물 설치와 접경지역 군사력 증강 등 소위 ‘국경선 요새화’ 추진에 대해 통합적·체계적으로 대응 중”이라고 했다. 사단급 대포병레이더, 다연장로켓 ‘천무’, 대드론통합체계, AI 과학화 경계체계 등을 보강해 대화력전 및 감시태세를 강화하겠다고 했다. 하지만 GOP 과학화경계체계 업그레이드 등은 2040년쯤에야 완료될 것으로 알려졌다.)

Meanwhile, the Defense Ministry announced that, in response to the recent controversies over unloaded ammunition at GP (Guard Post) and GOP border units, including those under the Army's 1st Corps, and the incident involving a misidentified U.S. drone, it has formed a "Joint Special Discipline Inspection Task Force" and initiated rigorous special inspections targeting major commands and corps-level units. (한편, 국방부는 최근 육군 1군단 등에서 발생한 GP·GOP 경계부대 미삽탄 논란과 미군 무인기 오인 소동에 대해 ‘합동특별기강점검TF’를 구성하고 주요 사령부 및 군단을 대상으로 강도 높은 특별점검에 착수했다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: People Power Party disciplines 'non-pro-Jang' lawmakers... Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, Seo Beom-soo, Jin Jong-oh suspended from party rights (국힘 ‘비장횡사’ 징계… 조경태·권영진·서범수·진종오 당원권 정지)
item.description:
People Power Party disciplines 'non-pro-Jang' lawmakers... Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, Seo Beom-soo, Jin Jong-oh suspended from party rights (국힘 ‘비장횡사’ 징계… 조경태·권영진·서범수·진종오 당원권 정지)

The People Power Party's ethics committee on the 20th handed down heavy disciplinary action—suspension of party rights—to lawmakers Cho Kyung-tae (Busan Saha-eul), Kwon Young-jin (Daegu Dalseo-byeong), Seo Beom-soo (Ulsan Ulju), and Jin Jong-oh (proportional representation). They were referred to the ethics committee for different reasons, but share a common thread: all have criticized party leader Jang Dong-hyuk. With multiple sitting lawmakers receiving heavy penalties, there is potential for internal factional conflict or defections from the party. (국민의힘 윤리위원회는 20일 조경태(부산 사하을), 권영진(대구 달서병), 서범수(울산 울주), 진종오(비례) 의원에게 ‘당원권 정지’ 중징계를 내렸다. 이들은 각자 다른 이유로 윤리위에 회부됐지만 장동혁 대표를 비판해 왔다는 공통점이 있다. 현역 의원에게 무더기 중징계가 내려지면서 당내 계파 갈등이나 탈당으로 이어질 가능성도 있다.)

The People Power Party's ethics committee announced on the evening of the 20th that it had imposed suspensions of party rights of 2 years and 6 months on Rep. Cho Kyung-tae, 2 years on Rep. Jin Jong-oh, and 1 year and 6 months and 10 months on Reps. Kwon Young-jin and Seo Beom-soo, respectively. Once party rights are suspended, members lose the right to vote and stand in intra-party elections such as the party leader race, and depending on party decisions, they may also lose their district party chairmanship positions. A People Power Party official said, "With the 2028 general election about 1 year and 8 months away, unless the next party leadership restores their rights, this effectively means excluding all but Rep. Seo from nomination." (국민의힘 윤리위는 이날 저녁 조경태 의원에게 2년 6개월, 진종오 의원에게 2년, 권영진 의원과 서범수 의원에게 각각 1년 6개월, 10개월의 당원권 정지 처분을 내린다고 발표했다. 당원권이 정지되면 당대표 선거 등 당내 선거권·피선거권이 정지되고, 당의 결정에 따라 당협위원장 자리도 잃을 수 있다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “2028년 총선이 약 1년 8개월쯤 남았기 때문에 차기 당 지도부가 복권시키지 않는 한 서 의원을 제외하면 사실상 공천에서 배제하겠다는 뜻”이라고 했다.)

The ethics committee can impose penalties such as expulsion, recommendation to leave the party, suspension of party rights, or warnings. Among these, expulsion requires approval by the supreme council. Suspension of party rights does not require supreme council approval, so the disciplinary procedure has been finalized. (윤리위는 제명, 탈당 권고, 당원권 정지, 경고 등의 징계를 내릴 수 있다. 이 중 제명은 최고위 의결을 거쳐야 한다. 당원권 정지는 최고위 의결이 필요 없어 징계 절차가 확정됐다.)

Earlier, Rep. Cho Kyung-tae was referred to the ethics committee after losing the intra-party race for the National Assembly vice speaker candidacy to Vice Speaker Park Deok-heum, and then, ahead of the plenary vote, asking opposition Democratic Party lawmakers to vote against Park. The ethics committee cited that Cho "acted against the party line and undermined party order" as the reason for discipline. Rep. Kwon Young-jin was subject to discipline for grabbing the collar of floor leader Chung Choun-sook last month out of dissatisfaction with his assignment to a standing committee. The ethics committee said it was "conduct unbecoming of a National Assembly member." (앞서 조경태 의원은 국회부의장 후보 당내 경선에서 박덕흠 부의장에게 져 탈락하자 본회의 투표를 앞두고 더불어민주당 의원들에게 박 부의장의 낙선을 요청했다는 이유로 윤리위에 제소됐다. 윤리위는 조 의원이 “당론에 반해 정당 질서를 해했다”고 징계 이유를 밝혔다. 권영진 의원은 지난달 국회 상임위원회 배치에 불만을 품고 정점식 원내대표를 찾아가 멱살을 잡았다는 이유로 징계 대상에 올랐다. 윤리위는 “국회의원으로서의 품위를 저버린 행위”라고 했다.)

Rep. Jin Jong-oh was referred to the ethics committee for helping independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon in the June by-elections, and the committee described it as "conduct undermining party order." Reps. Seo Beom-soo and Jin also made careless remarks at a National Assembly forum attended by Kim Jin-joo, the victim of the "Busan rundown" case, and the ethics committee said they "went against public sentiment." (진종오 의원은 지난 6월 국회의원 재·보궐 선거에서 무소속 한동훈 의원을 도왔다는 이유로 윤리위에 제소됐고, 윤리위는 “당의 질서를 해하는 행위”라고 했다. 서범수 의원과 진 의원은 ‘부산 돌려차기’ 사건 피해자 김진주씨가 참석하는 국회 간담회에서 실언을 했고, 윤리위는 “국민 정서에 반했다”고 했다.)

The four lawmakers are classified as members of the non-pro-leadership faction that has called for leader Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation. Reps. Seo Beom-soo and Jin Jong-oh are close to Rep. Han Dong-hoon, and Rep. Kwon Young-jin is close to Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon. Within the party, some have said, "Isn't this a case of 'non-pro-Jang' leaders being punished while pro-leadership members who sparked controversy over profanity and disparaging remarks about May 18 are not disciplined?" The People Power Party plans to hold a general assembly of lawmakers on the 21st, where non-pro-leadership lawmakers may push back. One lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area said, "There is a considerable possibility that factional conflicts that had simmered beneath the surface will resurface in the wake of this discipline." (네 의원은 장동혁 대표의 사퇴를 요구해온 비당권파로 분류된다. 서범수·진종오 의원은 한동훈 의원, 권영진 의원은 오세훈 서울시장과 가깝다. 당 일각에선 “욕설, 5·18 비하 논란을 빚은 당권파는 징계하지 않으면서 비당권파에 대해서만 징계하는, ‘비장(非張) 횡사 징계’ 아니냐”는 말도 나왔다. 국민의힘은 21일 의원총회를 열 예정인데 비당권파 의원들이 반발할 가능성도 있다. 한 수도권 의원은 “한동안 수면 아래로 가라앉았던 계파 갈등이 이번 징계를 계기로 떠오를 가능성이 적잖다”고 했다.)

Regarding the ethics committee's decision, Rep. Kwon Young-jin stated, "This is a mean-spirited, politically retaliatory punishment designed to silence and take revenge on lawmakers who criticize the pro-Jang faction and demand its exit," adding, "I'll wear this punishment as a badge of honor and fight even more confidently." Rep. Seo Beom-soo said, "I apologize for my careless remarks," but added, "I hope the ethics committee's judgment was not a predetermined decision aimed at eliminating political opponents." Reps. Cho Kyung-tae and Jin Jong-oh's camps are reportedly expected to release official statements on the 21st. (윤리위 결정에 대해 권영진 의원은 “장동혁 당권파를 비판하고 퇴진을 주장하는 의원의 입을 틀어막고 보복하기 위한 비열한 정치 보복성 징계”라며 “징계를 훈장으로 삼아 더 당당하게 싸우겠다”는 입장을 밝혔다. 서범수 의원은 “경솔한 언행에 대해 사과 말씀을 드린다”면서도 “윤리위 판단이 정적을 제거하는 답정너식 징계가 아니었기를 바란다”고 했다. 조경태 의원과 진종오 의원 측은 21일 공식 입장을 밝힐 것으로 알려졌다.)

There is also talk in political circles that Rep. Cho may leave the party. The disciplined lawmakers could also challenge the process and file for an injunction to suspend the disciplinary effect. In March, the ethics committee decided on penalties for Rep. Bae Hyun-jin and former supreme council member Kim Jong-hyuk, but the court accepted their injunction requests and blocked the measures, setting a precedent. (조 의원은 정치권에서 탈당 가능성도 거론된다. 징계 당사자들이 징계 절차 등을 문제 삼아 법원에 ‘징계 효력 정지’ 가처분을 신청할 가능성도 있다. 지난 3월 윤리위가 배현진 의원과 김종혁 전 최고위원에 대한 징계를 의결했으나, 법원이 이들의 가처분 신청을 받아들여 제동을 건 전례가 있다.)

Rep. Han Dong-hoon wrote on Facebook, "The selective and arbitrary disciplinary politics aimed at turning a public party into a private one continues," and warned, "The party will be abandoned by the people." (한동훈 의원은 페이스북에 “공당을 사당화하기 위한 선택적이고 자의적 징계 정치가 계속되고 있다”며 “국민들께 버림받게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Yun-deok "Partial Use of Yongsan Park"... Oh Se-hoon "Will Be a Sinner in History" (김윤덕 “용산공원 일부 활용”… 오세훈 “역사의 죄인 될 것”)
item.description:
Kim Yun-deok "Partial Use of Yongsan Park"... Oh Se-hoon "Will Be a Sinner in History" (김윤덕 “용산공원 일부 활용”… 오세훈 “역사의 죄인 될 것”)

On the 20th, Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon and Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yun-deok met regarding the creation of rental housing in Yongsan Park in Seoul. Minister Kim said, "It is not impossible to supply housing to young people and newlyweds," while Mayor Oh said, "I cannot agree under any circumstances." The two agreed to meet again next week, but their positions remain far apart. (서울 용산공원 임대주택 조성과 관련해 20일 오세훈 서울시장과 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관이 만났다. 김 장관은 “청년·신혼부부에게 주택을 공급하는 것이 불가능하지 않다”고 했고, 오 시장은 “어떤 경우에도 동의할 수 없다”고 했다. 두 사람은 다음 주 다시 만나기로 했지만 입장 차가 큰 상황이다.)

The two met for about an hour at a restaurant in Jung-gu, Seoul, that morning to exchange views on the creation of rental housing in Yongsan Park, the lifting of the Seoul green belt, and easing regulations on redevelopment and reconstruction. The government is pushing to build youth rental housing in Yongsan Park, which has been designated as a national park by law. In contrast, the Seoul Metropolitan Government opposes it, citing concerns such as damage to green space. (두 사람은 이날 오전 서울 중구의 한 식당에서 약 1시간 가량 만나 용산공원 임대주택 조성, 서울 그린벨트 해제, 재개발·재건축 규제 완화 등에 대해 의견을 교환했다. 정부는 법에 따라 국가공원으로 지정되어 있는 용산공원에 청년 임대주택 건설을 추진하고 있다. 반면 서울시는 녹지 훼손 등을 이유로 반대하고 있다.)

Immediately after the meeting, Minister Kim met with reporters and said, "Preserving Yongsan Park well and supplying housing to young people and newlyweds are not mutually incompatible," adding, "For example, places where homes were already built and lived in, such as the officer quarters (within the former Yongsan U.S. military base), can be used for housing supply." However, regarding the meeting itself, he said, "We clearly confirmed the differences in position." Mayor Oh held a briefing at Seoul City Hall immediately after the meeting and said, "Regarding Yongsan Park, we were on parallel lines." He added, "Yongsan Park is a key part of the green axis connecting Namsan to the Han River," and "If even a limited area is used for residential purposes, I would remain a sinner in history as the mayor of Seoul." (김 장관은 회동 직후 취재진과 만나 “용산공원을 잘 지키는 것과 청년과 신혼부부를 대상으로 주택을 공급하는 것이 양립 불가능하지 않다”며 “예를 들어 (기존 용산 미군기지 내) 장교 숙소처럼 이미 집을 짓고 살고 있던 곳은 주택 공급이 가능하다”고 했다. 다만 회동과 관련해선 “입장 차를 정확하게 확인했다”고 했다. 오 시장은 회동 직후 서울시청에서 브리핑을 열고 “용산공원에 대해서는 평행선이었다”고 했다. 그러면서 “용산공원은 남산부터 한강까지 이어지는 녹지 축의 주요 부분”이라며 “제한된 면적이라도 주거용으로 삼는다면 서울시장으로서 역사의 죄인으로 남을 것”이라고 했다.)

At the meeting that day, Mayor Oh said, "Let's discuss flexibly regarding sites near Yongsan Park." He proposed utilizing the Camp Kim site near Yongsan Park, the Ministry of National Defense Financial Management Corps site, the Bank of Korea dormitory, and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs parking lot. Minister Kim is also reported to have said about the easing of private reconstruction and redevelopment regulations that Mayor Oh has been demanding, "I think it is an important supply mechanism. We also need to proactively review ways to supply housing on vacant urban lots and other sites." (오 시장은 이날 만남에서 “용산공원 인근 부지에 대해서는 융통성 있게 논의하자”고 했다. 용산공원 인근의 캠프킴 부지, 국군재정관리단 부지, 한국은행 생활관, 외교부 주차장 등을 활용하자는 것이다. 김 장관도 오 시장이 요구해온 민간 재건축·재개발 규제 완화에 대해서 “중요한 공급 수단이라고 생각한다. 도심 나대지 등에 주택을 공급하는 방안도 함께 전향적으로 검토할 필요가 있다”고 말한 것으로 전해졌다.)

The Democratic Party of Korea has been arguing day after day that youth rental housing must be built in Yongsan Park. It has also criticized the Seoul Metropolitan Government's opposition, saying it is "holding back government policy." However, there are pointed out that this stance differs from that of past Democratic Party administrations. The Special Act on the Creation of Yongsan Park was enacted through national consensus during the Roh Moo-hyun administration, and now the Democratic Party is trying to change it to build apartments. President Lee Jae-myung also pledged during last year's presidential election campaign to open Yongsan Park to citizens and "create it as a rest space comparable to New York's Central Park." <<>> (더불어민주당은 용산공원에 청년 임대주택 조성이 필요하다고 연일 주장하고 있다. 서울시의 반대에 대해서도 “정부 정책의 발목을 잡고 있다”고 비판했다. 하지만 이런 입장은 역대 민주당 정부 때와 다르다는 지적이 나온다. 용산공원조성특별법은 노무현 정부 때 국민 합의로 제정됐는데 민주당이 이제와서 이를 바꿔 아파트를 짓겠다고 하는 것이다. 이재명 대통령도 지난해 대선 당시 용산공원을 시민에게 개방하고 “뉴욕 센트럴파크에 견줄 수 있는 휴식 공간으로 조성하겠다”고 공약했다.)

item.title: Third Korea-China Summit Expected at APEC in Shenzhen in November (11월 中 선전 APEC서 세번째 한중정상회담)
item.description:
Third Korea-China Summit Expected at APEC in Shenzhen in November (11월 中 선전 APEC서 세번째 한중정상회담)

President Lee Jae-myung met with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi at the presidential office on the 20th. The presidential office stated that President Lee will visit China on the occasion of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders' meeting to be held in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China, in November, and meet with President Xi Jinping, saying, "I hope we can together create fruitful outcomes that contribute to the lives of both nations' people and that Korea-China relations will become even stronger." (이재명 대통령이 20일 청와대에서 왕이(王毅) 중국 외교부장을 접견했다. 이 대통령은 11월 중국 광둥성 선전에서 개최되는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 계기에 중국을 방문해 시진핑 국가주석을 만나게 된다며 “양국 국민의 삶에 기여할 수 있는 풍성한 성과를 함께 만들어 가고 한·중 관계도 더욱 돈독해지길 희망한다”고 말했다고 청와대가 밝혔다.)

President Lee held a summit with President Xi during his state visit to South Korea in November last year on the occasion of the APEC meeting held in Gyeongju, and made a state visit to Beijing, China, in January this year. Accordingly, a third Korea-China summit since his inauguration is expected to take place in Shenzhen, China, in November. President Lee said, "Since meeting President Xi in consecutive years last year and this year, we are achieving tangible results in the full restoration of Korea-China relations." (이 대통령은 작년 11월 경주에서 열린 APEC 계기에 국빈 방한한 시 주석과 정상회담을 했고, 올해 1월엔 중국 베이징을 국빈 방문했다. 이에 따라 11월에는 중국 선전에서 취임 후 세 번째 한·중 정상회담이 열릴 전망이다. 이 대통령은 “작년과 올해 연이어 시 주석을 만난 이후 한·중 관계 전면 복원이라는 확실한 성과를 만들어 가고 있다”고 했다.)

China's state-run Xinhua News Agency reported that Foreign Minister Wang said at the meeting, "President Lee has made the right choices since taking office, putting Korea-China relations back on track." It also reported that he said, "Embracing China is embracing the future, and walking with China is walking with opportunity," expressing hope that South Korea will firmly pursue a policy of friendship toward China. Regarding the Korean Peninsula issue, the presidential office stated, "President Lee asked Foreign Minister Wang to maintain close strategic communication with Foreign Minister Cho Hyun and National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac on Korea-China relations and Korean Peninsula issues." (중국 관영 신화통신은 왕 부장이 이 자리에서 “이 대통령이 취임 뒤 올바른 선택을 내려 한·중 관계를 정상 궤도에 돌려놓았다”고 말했다고 전했다. 또 “중국을 포용하는 것은 미래를 포용하는 것이며, 중국과 동행하는 것은 기회와 동행하는 것”이라며 한국이 대중국 우호 정책을 확고히 추구하길 바란다고 말했다고 보도했다. 한반도 문제에 대해 청와대는 “이 대통령은 왕 부장에게 조현 외교장관, 위성락 국가안보실장과 한·중 관계 및 한반도 문제 등에 대해 긴밀한 전략적 소통을 이어가 줄 것을 당부했다”고 밝혔다.)

Foreign Minister Wang, who also serves as director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission of the Chinese Communist Party, held a separate meeting with National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac at the presidential office that day. The presidential office said that Director Wi requested China's cooperation on South Korea's policy toward the North, which focuses on 'halting' the advancement of North Korea's nuclear capabilities, and that Foreign Minister Wang responded that he would continue to play a constructive role for peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula. However, the previous day, when asked by reporters at the foreign ministry whether China would mediate a North Korea-U.S. summit, Foreign Minister Wang said, "That is for North Korea and the United States to decide." (중국공산당 중앙외사판공실 주임을 겸하고 있는 왕 부장은 이날 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장과도 따로 회담했다. 위 실장은 이 자리에서 북핵 능력 고도화 ‘중단’에 초점을 맞춘 우리 대북 정책에 대한 중국의 협력을 요청했고, 왕 부장도 한반도 평화·안정을 위한 건설적 역할을 계속해 나가겠다고 답했다고 청와대는 전했다. 하지만 왕 부장은 전날 외교부에서 ‘북미 정상회담을 중재할 것이냐’는 취재진 물음에 “그것은 북한과 미국 사이에 결정할 일”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Forces Through Fast-Track Law Shortening Process (與, 패스트트랙 단축법 처리 강행)
item.description:
Ruling Party Forces Through Fast-Track Law Shortening Process (與, 패스트트랙 단축법 처리 강행)

The Democratic Party of Korea passed a revision to the National Assembly Act on the 20th at a plenary session, shortening the review period for fast-track (expedited processing) items from a maximum of 330 days to 90 days. Even if the opposition party objects, once a bill is placed on the fast track, the Democratic Party, holding the majority of seats, can now push it through the plenary session more quickly. Bills such as the mega-special economic zone special law and follow-up legislation related to real estate, which are being led by the government and the ruling party, will now pass the National Assembly after 90 days even if they fail to clear the threshold of the National Assembly's Trade, Industry, Energy, SMEs, and Startups Committee and the Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Committee, both chaired by the People Power Party. The People Power Party criticized, saying, "With this vicious law, the National Assembly is no longer the last bastion of democracy but the vanguard of Lee Jae-myung's dictatorship." <<> On this day, the ruling and opposition parties also passed the recommendation motion for special inspector candidates Choi Gil-soo, Kang Ji-sik, and Choi Yong-hoon, all lawyers. If the president designates one of these three within three days of receiving the National Assembly's recommendation, the special inspector will be finally appointed after going through a confirmation hearing at the National Assembly. If a special inspector is appointed this time, the position, which remained vacant because neither the Moon Jae-in nor the Yoon Suk-yeol administration appointed one, will be filled for the first time in 10 years. The special inspector is a vice-ministerial-level political appointment tasked with inspecting the president's spouse, relatives within the fourth degree of kinship, and officials at the level of senior presidential secretary or above. The term of office is three years. <<> On this day, the ruling and opposition parties also agreed and passed about 70 bills, including the May 18 Democratization Movement Compensation Act, which stipulates a special exception to the statute of limitations for claims for damages by people who suffered mental harm related to the May 18 democratization movement. Also passed were the Public Housing Act, which reviews long-term unused non-residential land as part of the follow-up measures to the September 7 supply plan to supply housing, and the Special Act on Complex Development of School Sites. (더불어민주당이 20일 국회 본회의에서 패스트트랙(신속처리안건)의 심사 기한을 최장 330일에서 90일로 단축하는 국회법 개정안을 통과시켰다. 야당이 반대해도 법안을 패스트트랙에 태우면 다수석을 가진 민주당이 더 빠르게 본회의 처리를 할 수 있게 됐다. 정부·여당이 주도하고 있는 메가특구 특별법, 부동산 관련 후속 입법 등도 국민의힘이 상임위원장인 국회 산업통상자원중소벤처기업위원회·국토교통위원회 문턱을 넘지 못해도 90일 뒤엔 국회를 통과하는 것이다. 국민의힘은 “이 악법으로 이제 국회는 민주주의 최후 보루가 아니라 이재명 독재 정권의 최첨병이 됐다”고 비판했다.)

item.title: "Unknown Even to the Army Chief of Staff"… The Full Story Behind the 'Release of Anti-Communist Prisoners' That Stunned the World (“육참총장도 모르게”… 세계를 놀라게 한 ‘반공 포로 석방’의 전말)
item.description:
"Unknown Even to the Army Chief of Staff"… The Full Story Behind the 'Release of Anti-Communist Prisoners' That Stunned the World (“육참총장도 모르게”… 세계를 놀라게 한 ‘반공 포로 석방’의 전말)

Army Chief of Staff Baek Seon-yeop was in a hurry to report his return to President Syngman Rhee at Gyeongmudae, but his path was blocked by protesters shouting for "unification by advancing north." The crowd showed no sign of dispersing. The day was growing darker. Baek Seon-yeop said he climbed onto the hood of his jeep. He then identified himself to the protesters and shouted, "I need to see the President at Gyeongmudae, please clear the way." At that, one or two people in the crowd slowly stepped aside, and finally a path opened up. <<> Arriving at Gyeongmudae that way, Baek Seon-yeop finished his return greetings to the President and then made an important report. He conveyed to President Rhee the contents of his conversation with Eisenhower. But contrary to expectations, the President's expression was deeply somber. After hearing his brief report, the President said flatly, "I see. You may go now." <<> Baek Seon-yeop recalled, "The President seemed to have already heard the U.S. administration's position on the mutual defense treaty from Mark Clark, the U.N. Forces commander," adding, "It was the expression he wore when making some grave decision." In early June 1953, when he returned from the United States, the country was entering a period of deep tension, as evident from Rhee's face. <<> The armistice talks with the communist side had been back-and-forth from the very moment they began. As with all negotiations with the communists, even setting a clear agenda was a series of difficulties. Such wrangling continued unabated until the armistice was formally concluded on July 27, 1953. But as the ceasefire loomed, the biggest issue to emerge was how to handle prisoners of war with anti-communist leanings. <<> The U.N. side, eager to hasten the armistice, tended to show little concern for prisoners who refused repatriation to their home countries. Their stance was to bring in neutral nations and establish a "Commission for Repatriation of Prisoners Who Refuse Repatriation" to handle the matter. Though they should have kept in mind the possibility of communist threats and enticements during the screening process, the U.N. side paid little attention to such "details." <<> President Rhee took the opposite stance. He insisted that anti-communist prisoners must unconditionally be embraced within the fold of freedom. When the U.N. and communist sides put forward a plan to handle them through the commission at the truce talks in Panmunjom, the Republic of Korea government immediately objected. It issued an official government statement declaring, "We cannot accept the compromise. Anti-communist prisoners must be released immediately." <<> Baek Seon-yeop was well aware of that atmosphere in his own way. He once recounted, "The President was not unconditionally opposed to the armistice. If he was in a position where he could not refuse a ceasefire due to the balance of power, then the ROK was in a situation where it had to maximize its own interests in between. The President saw that point further ahead than anyone else, and I understood that he had made a momentous decision accordingly." <<> But the situation kept growing more serious. President Rhee eventually withdrew Major General Choe Deok-sin, who had been attending the truce talks as Korea's representative. Yet the atmosphere suggested even more weighty measures were to come. As a gambler, Rhee's temperament was reaching its peak. It was a bold move that could overturn the flow of the game, which until then had followed the intentions of the U.N. and communist sides. <<> The signs naturally caught the eye of Baek Seon-yeop, then serving as Army Chief of Staff. It was the President's sudden creation of a "Provost Marshal General Headquarters." The Army headquarters already had a provost marshal, and the military police system was functioning well under it. Yet the President established another body, a redundant layer on top, called the "Provost Marshal General Headquarters." Though puzzled, Baek Seon-yeop had no choice but to watch the measure unfold. <<> It was around June 10. The President urgently summoned key commanders to Gyeongmudae. The Army Chief of Staff naturally attended the meeting. Baek Seon-yeop remembered that despite it being "an extraordinary meeting held in extraordinary times," the atmosphere was calm. President Rhee, seated on a chair in the middle of the courtyard, called out, "Chief of Staff Baek, where are you?" <<> When Baek approached after hearing "Come here," the President said to him in a low voice, "You know Won Yong-deok, right? I've given Won Yong-deok a task, so be aware of that." Prior to that, the President had suddenly created the "Provost Marshal General Headquarters" and placed General Won Yong-deok as its commander. Something seemed to be moving urgently. <<> Baek Seon-yeop could not help but ponder this matter. Through his own channels, he was able to discern what the President was planning. However, he could not comment on the President's top-secret undertaking. He stopped at the level of "conjecture." He judged that digging deeper into the details would do no good. Gradually, signs that the President's intentions were becoming reality began to emerge. This was accompanied by the increasingly frequent actions of the "Provost Marshal General Headquarters" led by General Won Yong-deok. <<> The President was about to hurl a massive shockwave at the world. It was the wholesale release of anti-communist prisoners of war, whose fate had been decided through lengthy negotiations between the U.N. Command and the communist forces. The truce talks, which had continued through all sorts of twists and turns, were in danger of collapsing into nothing as a result. <<> But the President's move was audacious. Backed by such support, Commander Won Yong-deok grew bold. The President's orders came down, and on the evening of June 18, Won's Provost Marshal General Headquarters toured each prisoner-of-war camp. They first cut the camps' barbed wire and electricity, it is said. They also distributed clothing and other items to anti-communist prisoners who had escaped the camps through prior arrangements, aiding their mass breakout. As the news was transmitted, the world was truly left in shock. The great reversal of the "release of anti-communist prisoners" had thus revealed itself in full. (경무대로 이승만 대통령을 찾아가 귀국 보고를 해야 하는 백선엽 총장은 마음이 급했으나 “북진 통일”을 외치는 시위대에 행로가 막힌 상태였다. 시위대는 대열을 풀 생각이 없는 듯했다. 날은 자꾸 어두워져 가고 있었다. 백선엽은 그때 지프 위의 보닛에 올라갔다고 했다. 그는 이어 시위대를 향해 자신이 누군지를 밝히면서 “경무대로 대통령을 뵈러 가야 하니 길을 열어달라”고 외쳤다고 한다. 그러자 시위대의 군중 한두 명이 조금씩 비켜나더니 마침내 길을 터줬다고 한다.)
